doc: A finished tile of grass, centred on a pointy-top hex cell of circumradius 1 m, ready to draw: instanced across a field and swayed by the wind in the vertex shader.

fields.name: radius
fields.doc: The tile's reach from its centre, metres.

fields.name: colors
fields.doc: Per vertex, packed RGBA (red in the lowest byte); alpha 255 on grass (the cell's tint applies), 0 on the ground (it doesn't).

fields.name: sway
fields.doc: Per vertex: how far it moves in a 10 m/s wind, metres (0 at the ground).
